title: Quote of the day by The Odyssey director Chris Nolan: 'AI researchers refer to the present moment as an 'Oppenheimer moment'' — putting into perspective the scale of change AI will bring
excerpt: The seasoned director sees the emergence of AI as akin to the initial testing around nuclear fission that led to the atom bomb
content_html:
The unintended consequences of progress, including the risks and possible harms caused, are always a factor that scientists and engineers consider in building any new technology. In today's age, the spotlight is on AI – but the range of possibilities that progress might bring is near unfathomable.

I am become death

Chris Nolan, director of a string of cinematic successes across the last three decades, was speaking on the subject matter of his 2023 blockbuster 'Oppenheimer' during a press tour.

Quote of the day

This article is part of TechRadar Pro's QOTD project to provide an insight into the minds of the brightest and most recognized figures in the technology industry today and in years gone by. Read the full series here.

During a New York panel following a preview screening of the film, Nolan was speaking on the rise of AI, which has fallen into perspective after showing immense promise.

Although the mainstream image of AI has been coloured by a string of science-fiction movies throughout history, there are still valid questions to be asked about the unintended consequences of building and releasing new tools without an awful lot of testing.

Similar to the nature of the work that scientist J Robert Oppenheimer did on the Manhattan Project, there is a "dual-use dilemma" in the way that AI could either be used for good or to cause catastrophic harm.

Unintended consequences

Similar to fears expressed during that period of history, scientists and researchers frequently warn about ways in which AI can either be misaligned or spiral out of control, or ways in which people can exploit it for malicious intent.

A study published in May 2024, for example, highlights the possible risks of a future AI that could deceive humans. It uses documented examples as a springboard to speculate that a future system may decide to mislead humanity for purposes that differ from the humans that built and use it.

There are also flaws with these parallels, namely, unlike nuclear weapons, AI development spans thousands of organizations around the world. There's also a dominance in the private sector, a much lower barrier to entry, and more difficulties in verifying and inspecting whether AI is being used in positive or harmful ways.

Keumars Afifi-Sabet is a freelance contributor for Tech Radar and the Technology Editor for Live Science. He has written for a variety of publications including ITPro, The Week Digital and ComputerActive. He has worked as a technology journalist for more than five years, having previously held the role of features editor with ITPro. In his previous role, he oversaw the commissioning and publishing of long form in areas including AI, cyber security, cloud computing and digital transformation.

进步的意外后果，包括风险和可能造成的危害，始终是科学家和工程师在构建任何新技术时考虑的一个因素。 在当今时代，人工智能是人们关注的焦点，但进步可能带来的可能性几乎是深不可测的。

我已成为死亡

克里斯·诺兰 (Chris Nolan) 是过去三十年中一系列成功电影的导演，他在一次新闻发布会上谈到了他 2023 年的大片《奥本海默》的主题。

当日报价

本文是 TechRadar Pro 的 QOTD 项目的一部分，旨在深入了解当今和过去几年技术行业中最聪明、最受认可的人物的想法。 在这里阅读完整系列。

在电影预映后的纽约座谈会上，诺兰谈到了人工智能的崛起，人工智能在展现出巨大的前景后，已经受到人们的关注。

尽管人工智能的主流形象在历史上一直被一系列科幻电影所渲染，但对于在没有进行大量测试的情况下构建和发布新工具所带来的意想不到的后果，仍然存在一些有效的问题。

与科学家 J·罗伯特·奥本海默在曼哈顿计划中所做的工作性质类似，人工智能既可以用于行善，也可以用于造成灾难性伤害，因此存在“双重用途困境”。

意想不到的后果

与那段历史时期所表达的恐惧类似，科学家和研究人员经常警告人工智能可能会出现偏差或失控，或者人们可能会利用人工智能来进行恶意利用。

例如，2024 年 5 月发表的一项研究强调了未来人工智能可能欺骗人类的潜在风险。 它使用记录的示例作为跳板，推测未来的系统可能会决定误导人类，以达到与构建和使用它的人类不同的目的。

这些相似之处也存在缺陷，即与核武器不同，人工智能开发涉及世界各地数千个组织。 此外，私营部门占据主导地位，进入门槛低得多，验证和检查人工智能是否被用于积极或有害的方式也更加困难。

Keumars Afifi-Sabet 是 Tech Radar 的自由撰稿人和 Live Science 的技术编辑。 他曾为多种出版物撰写文章，包括 ITPro、The Week Digital 和 ComputerActive。 他担任技术记者已有五年多，此前曾担任 ITPro 的专题编辑。 在之前的职位中，他负责监督人工智能、网络安全、云计算和数字化转型等领域的长篇文章的调试和发布。
